rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the allowable annual rent increase is 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Prior periods were 1.4% for 2025-26 and 1.7% for 2024-25.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent increase limits under the SF Rent Ordinance apply to units in buildings with a certificate of occupancy on or before June 13, 1979. This cutoff comes from the published program rule, not from this page.

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits at the annual rate set by the Rent Board: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Prior rates were 5.0% for 2025-26 and 5.2% for 2024-25.
rules.key_value: 4.2% annual interest on security deposits (Mar 1, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027)

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of a unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work (20 days or more), or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation. For eviction notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, the amount is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit. An additional $5,497.00 is due for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; max $24,733.00 per unit; +$5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children (notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to the listed no-fault eviction grounds. Temporary capital improvement displacements of less than 20 days are governed instead by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are excluded (governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9).
rules.interaction: Short temporary displacements (<20 days) are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 rather than § 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation. For eviction notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, the amount is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit. An additional $7,443.90 is due for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant (notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Evictions under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market).
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days (San Francisco)
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement displacements of less than 20 days, relocation is governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 rather than the SF Rent Ordinance. For notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, the amount is $446.00 per day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses.
rules.key_value: $446.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses (notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Temporary displacement for capital improvement work lasting less than 20 days, in San Francisco.
rules.interaction: Displaces S.F. Admin. Code § 37.9C relocation amounts for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.conflict_note: The page states that this state statute, not the local Rent Ordinance § 37.9C, governs relocation for displacements under 20 days, so state law displaces the local amount for these evictions. The effective date shown is the start of the current rate period, not the statute's enactment date.
